label: created, in the act of describing
notes: Eleven route-keepers and two rim-city councils wrote down what had until then been custom, and the document made the Wardenry by defining it. The calendar has counted from it for two centuries. It has been amended exactly once, in RR 167, and that amendment is what the last two chapters are about. An institution that wrote its own charter has nobody to appeal to when the charter runs out.
